description: South Korea monthly wage withholding tax from the official simplified withholding table (근로소득 간이세액표, 소득세법 시행령 별표2, revised 2026-02-27): table lookup by monthly pay (excluding non-taxable pay and tuition) and number of dependants incl. self and spouse, the statutory formulas above 10,000,000 KRW, the child reduction for children aged 8-20 (20,830 / 45,830 / +33,330 each beyond 2), more than 11 dependants (note 4), the 80/100/120% option (시행령 제194조) and 10% local income tax. Withholding only; final tax is set at year-end settlement.
